purpose: Prevent unadjusted corporate-action or other unverified raw-price discontinuities from becoming apparent alpha.

source_context.twse_rule: Ordinary TWSE stocks generally have a daily price fluctuation limit of 10% around the opening reference price, with explicit exceptions such as the first five trading days of certain new listings.
source_context.important_caveat: A >15% close-to-close change is not asserted to be a corporate action. It is only treated as an unverified discontinuity because the reset corpus lacks complete PIT corporate-action/listing-exception lineage.

sensitivity_requirement: Any leading candidate must later be rechecked with a documented alternative discontinuity treatment; no winner may depend materially on these excluded events.
